message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. The case: two defendants beat victim, victim died due to acute coronary attack triggered by fight, with physical injuries (nasal fracture). The prosecution says they should be charged with 故意伤害 (intentional injury) leading to death. In Chinese criminal law, causing death by intentional injury is still intentional injury (if no intent to kill). Could be "故意伤害致死" which is still under intentional injury. So charge is 故意伤害. Possibly also "故意伤害致人死亡" but label is just 故意伤害. The example earlier: similar case with wife beating leading to death had "故意伤害;虐待". But here only intentional injury. So answer: [罪名]故意伤害<eoa>. No other charges.

Thus JSON with reasoning and final answer.
